title: Determine applicable authority before governed actions
description: Determines whether a proposed governed action is covered by applicable project policy and authorization, including bounded standing delegation. It preserves human decision boundaries without requiring repeated permission for actions already covered by a valid grant.
inputs: Proposed action, subject, scope, conditions, and acting participant.
Applicable project policy, decision owners, and recorded grants including conditions, limits, revocation, completion, or supersession.
preconditions: The proposed action and selected project context are identifiable.
outputs: Applicable authorization basis or the specific unmet decision boundary.
Action permitted within the grant or withheld from execution pending the required decision.
behavior: Identify whether policy reserves the action for a human decision and assess the applicable owner, grant, scope, conditions, and limits.
Recognize a valid prior grant or bounded standing delegation across sessions and covered steps without treating a resumed session as reason for new approval.
Reject reliance on an expired-by-completion, revoked, superseded, out-of-scope, conditionally invalid, or higher-authority-conflicting grant.
Withhold a governed action when its required authorization is absent and identify the particular decision needed.
Keep evidence, favorable assessments, next-action suggestions, and permission for other work separate from authority; do not let delegation waive required independent assessment.

failure_behavior.condition: Governing policy, required owner, or applicable grant is missing or conflicting.
failure_behavior.outcome: Identify the unresolved authority boundary and do not perform the reserved action.

failure_behavior.condition: The proposed action exceeds a prior grant or a relevant condition has changed.
failure_behavior.outcome: Withhold the uncovered action while preserving recognition of the grant for any still-covered scope.

unallocated_reason: Architectural responsibility is deliberately deferred until the logical requirements and system design are reconciled. This Function establishes behavior, not a Module, Interface, implementation, or verification result.

sources.basis: Existing SR-007 confirms authority enforcement under IR-003. It uses the selected project policy rather than establishing a universal approval workflow.
